question: Identify an organism that has a well-defined muscular pharynx.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ascaris.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ascaris**:-

 
 
• It is a** nematode worm** that belongs to the **phylum Nematoda.**
 
• It is a parasitic organism that infects the** intestines of humans** and other animals.
